main_text.p: 4 Hoc anno Christi millesimo centesimo & nonagesimo primo, die 23 Martii, feria septima, ob-seruauit Hebræus quidam ingressum solis in arietis constellationem, vt in scripto eius videre licet, quod cum Messahala & Saraceno Norimbergæ est editum. Vt autem tempus obseruationis suæ satis declararet, addidit cum insigniores æras accommodauit: primum enim ostendit se considerationem hanc suscepisse completis annis Christi 1190, & 81 diebus, & transactis annis Arabicis 586, & 54 diebus. Sanè anni Arabici 586, & 54 dies conficiunt in vniuersum dies 207713, hoc est, annos æquabiles 569, & viginti octo dies: qui si adiiciantur ad annos Na-bonassari mille trecentos sexaginta nouem, & cen-tum septendecim dies ante æram Arabum elapsos, confur-

page.notes: Doubtful: the mark after 1191 in the Christi column ("1191[?]") is unclear. The Arabic years "586" and "54" and the number "207713" are read from a small, worn print and may be misread. Possible "Messahala" spelling is read as printed. The "4" before "Hoc anno" is a paragraph number. The table has no heading. Running head is set in spaced capitals. No catchword or signature is visible.
